violations.why: Once zenith has run once, interrupt 2 stays enabled (global mask state). On a later zenith run, irq_indigo (higher priority) can preempt between the two writes and read the intermediate value 0.

After zenith sets v_willow and enables ISR 2, irq_indigo can preempt the task between its clearing write of v_quartz[9999] and the later write of 1. It reads the intermediate value 0, so the task's two writes are not atomic.
